title: Per-action policy findings (v2.2)
description: Structured record of what a single source document says about a single climate action. One record per (action, source_document) pair. v2.2 separates policy relation from action-match directness and records the policy subject used in that comparison.

action_id.description: Stable identifier for the action (e.g. icare_0001).

action_gpc_reference.description: GPC sector reference for the action (e.g. I.4.4).

relevance.description: Overall relevance of the document to the action. 'none' means the document has nothing meaningful to say about this action.

summary.description: One-sentence English summary of what the document says about the action. Empty string if relevance=none.

early_exit.description: True when the model determined relevance=none after a cheap scan and chose not to enumerate empty findings. Distinguishes a deliberate 'nothing to say' decision from a fail-silent empty-findings response.

findings.description: Verbatim passages from the document classified by primitive_type. Empty array when relevance=none or early_exit=true.

atom_id.description: Stable identifier of the source atom used for this finding.

primitive_type.description: What KIND of policy statement this is.

primitive_relation.description: How the passage relates to the action. commits = explicit commitment to act; targets = quantified/dated target; funds = funding allocation; monitors = MRV indicator or review cycle; governs = lead body or instrument; prioritizes = names the action's theme as priority; identifies = names a risk, gap, or enabling condition; contextualizes = background/framing; restates = restates a higher-level commitment without adding new content; references = points to another instrument.

match_type.description: How closely the policy subject matches the catalogue action: direct=same intervention, indirect=concrete enabling measure, contextual=useful framing only.

policy_subject.description: Short noun phrase naming the intervention or subject actually addressed by the policy passage.

subject_match_reason.description: One sentence comparing the policy subject with the catalogue action's object and mechanism.

signal_confidence.description: Confidence that this passage genuinely supports the action.

evidence_text.description: Verbatim substring of the source document. Must pass an exact-substring check (whitespace-normalised) against document.md to be accepted.

page.description: Page number from the nearest preceding <!-- page_break: N --> marker.

page_end.description: End page when the passage spans multiple pages.

section.description: Nearest preceding ## section heading, for human navigation.

sector_tags.description: Sector tags copied from the source atom for downstream filtering.

measure_type.description: Whether the passage frames the commitment as mitigation, adaptation, both, or unknown.

explicitness.description: explicit = passage directly addresses the action; inferred = passage addresses a closely related concept and the connection requires interpretation.

applicability_scope.description: Which territory the passage applies to when the source document covers a region or intercommunal area. Free text but should resolve to a region or commune name where possible. Empty for national or single-commune documents.

restatement_of.description: When primitive_relation=restates, optionally points to the higher-level instrument being restated.

relevance_note.description: One sentence explaining how this passage supports (or constrains) the action.

absent_primitive_types.description: Primitive types the document does NOT cover for this action — useful for showing coverage gaps.

caveats.description: Free text noting restatements, scope limitations, or ambiguities the reviewer should know.
